name: @zelyra/web-editor
description: Self-hosted browser editor assets for the Zelyra CLI

scripts.build: esbuild src/theme.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../cli/assets/theme.js && esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../cli/assets/editor.js && esbuild src/editor.css --bundle --minify --outfile=../cli/assets/editor.css
scripts.test: npm run test:ui-metadata && npm run test:language
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser-hover && npm run test:browser-pdf && npm run test:browser-rename && npm run test:browser-canvas && npm run test:browser-capability && npm run test:browser-runtime-budget && npm run test:browser-capabilities && npm run test:browser-external-change && npm run test:browser-pipeline && npm run test:browser-runtime && npm run test:browser-semantic && npm run test:browser-module-settings
